opening.argument: The webinar presents a paid Bitclub earning opportunity: entry requires a stated $99 membership fee, while the speaker describes pool positions on both sides and income tied to cycles in a downline. It also holds out an unusually large return, saying someone could have made “almost 200.000 dollars from 6.500 dollars in the last 24 months.” Alongside the recruitment-linked structure, those claims depict money multiplication and substantial earnings. The underlying transactions and outcomes are not verified, but the combination of required payment, downline income, and extraordinary projected returns supports treating the offer as deceptive paid-return promotion.
